beats.headline: ASML drops 3.1% divergent from customer Intel
beats.explanation: ASML fell 3.13% to $1317.23 on 1.5 times average volume with no company-specific news reported. The drop was largely company-specific, as customer Intel rose 4.89% while customer TSMC slipped 0.72%.

beats.headline: ASML declines 4.8% following 6-K filing
beats.explanation: ASML fell 4.79% to $1410.83 on 2.1 times average volume after filing a Form 6-K on April 15. The retreat was shared in part with customer TSMC, which dropped 3.13%, while customer Intel gained 5.48%.

beats.headline: ASML climbs 4.0% in company-specific advance
beats.explanation: ASML advanced 3.99% to $1581.58 on 1.4 times normal volume without company-specific news disclosures. The rise was company-specific, as customer TSMC rose just 0.63% and customer Intel fell 0.27%.

beats.headline: ASML rises 4.7% to $1705.37
beats.explanation: ASML gained 4.72% to finish at $1705.37 on 1.2 times average volume without company-specific announcements. It shared positive momentum with customer TSMC, which rose 2.54%, whereas customer Intel fell 1.28%.

beats.headline: ASML falls 6.6% in broad customer selloff
beats.explanation: ASML dropped 6.58% to $1641.74 on volume 2.2 times its 30-day average with no company-specific news. The drop was shared with its primary customers, as TSMC lost 6.69% and Intel dropped 11.28%.

beats.headline: ASML surges 9.5% tracking customer rally
beats.explanation: ASML climbed 9.53% to $1899.48 on 2.4 times average volume without company-specific news releases. The surge was shared across its customer network, as Intel jumped 9.27% and TSMC rose 3.01%.

beats.headline: ASML advances 3.3% as customers climb
beats.explanation: ASML gained 3.31% to close at $1929.68 on 1.9 times normal volume without fresh corporate news. Upward momentum was shared with customers Intel and TSMC, which gained 10.64% and 6.93% on the day.

beats.headline: ASML rebounds 4.4% on high volume
beats.explanation: ASML rose 4.45% to $1841.18 on 1.8 times average volume in the absence of specific corporate news. The gain was largely company-specific, contrasting with customer TSMC's 1.32% decline while customer Intel rose 0.93%.

beats.headline: ASML climbs 3.6% alongside Intel and TSMC
beats.explanation: ASML rose 3.59% to $1801.51 on 1.4 times normal volume without direct corporate updates. The move was shared with customers Intel and TSMC, which advanced 8.64% and 5.55%, respectively.

beats.headline: ASML drops 5.8% outstripping peer declines
beats.explanation: ASML slid 5.79% to $1655.26 on elevated volume of 2.7 times average without company-specific news. The sharp drop was mostly company-specific, far outpacing mild decreases of 0.70% at customer Intel and 1.07% at customer TSMC.

beats.headline: ASML rises 6.5% alongside customer rally
beats.explanation: ASML rallied 6.50% to $1651.44 on 1.8 times 30-day average volume with no company-specific announcements. The rally was shared with customer Intel, which surged 11.30%, and customer TSMC, which gained 7.64%.

beats.headline: ASML gains 3.1% on installed base sales surge
beats.explanation: ASML advanced 3.08% to $1679.92 on twice its average volume as reports highlighted a 31.8% surge in Installed Base Management revenue. Reports also noted delivery demand testing throughput on 110 EUV machines. The gain was company-specific, as customer TSMC gained 1.02% and customer Intel fell 0.18%.

arc: Between April and September 2026, ASML experienced substantial appreciation, lifting from $1317.23 in early April to $1679.92 by mid-September despite sharp cyclical swings. Throughout June and July, the stock exhibited intense volatility that closely mirrored synchronous double-digit and mid-single-digit swings at its key EUV lithography customers, Intel and TSMC, rather than company-specific announcements. By September, company-specific drivers came to the forefront, highlighted by a 31.8% growth rate in Installed Base Management revenues and high manufacturing throughput demands on 110 EUV units to support AI infrastructure buildouts.
